run_split_cub_training: run the split CUB continual learning experiment with specified architecture and importance method
train_task_sequence: train a sequence of tasks using LLL methods like EWC, PI, MAS, or A-GEM
test_task_sequence: test the model accuracy across all previously seen tasks in the sequence
get_arguments: parse CLI arguments for the split CUB experiment including architecture, optimizer, and model options
save_load_checkpoints: save or load TensorFlow model checkpoints to and from disk for resuming training
